exclusion_rule: Before sampling: missing/non-string public fields, invalid entry identifier, non-docstring-only prompt, absent/inconsistent public call arity, or keyword/starred calls. No evaluation-performance exclusions.
interface_rule: Preserve original public prompt; infer consistent positional arity only from its public assertions and append generic arg0, arg1, ... signature. Do not inspect canonical_solution, input contract, hidden inputs, tolerance or hidden labels.
split_rule: Among structurally supported tasks, sort ascending SHA256('tgselect-v1:' + task_id), with task_id as hash-collision tiebreak; first pilot -> e0, next total-pilot -> e1, remainder -> heldout. Heldout prompts are saved but not generated in E0/E1.
